$description: Struct-level golden vectors for postFieldBytes — the PostCommit payload inside its creating transaction's TxId preimage (TYPES_INTERFACE → Layout — PostCommit). The encode direction runs the production writer; the decode direction runs an independent reader written from the layout table, so a vector also proves the preimage is self-delimiting and canonical. A post id is NOT derived from these bytes — it comes from the creating transaction.

vectors.name: postCommit/minimal
vectors.note: 67 bytes: 32 contentHash, 32 author, 1 count, 1 version, 1 type. Every field at its zero value. contentHash is zeroed, not a real hash; protocolVersion sits below its protocol minimum — the ENCODER has no such rules.

vectors.name: postCommit/golden
vectors.note: 99 bytes, and THE cross-implementation anchor. contentHash is computeContentHash('dagsocial golden vector ✓'). Adjacent fields hold distinct non-zero values (contentHash from content, author 00..1f, ref 11..), because a transposition of two same-width fields is invisible at zeros.

vectors.name: postCommit/no-refs
vectors.note: postCommit/golden with the ref removed: exactly 32 bytes shorter. A ref costs the 32 raw bytes it names and nothing else.

vectors.name: postCommit/wide-numerics
vectors.note: contentHash is computeContentHash('x'). protocolVersion at MAX_SAFE_INTEGER — eight bytes, the top of the encodable number domain. type is enum8, fixed at one byte.

vectors.name: postCommit/multibyte-content
vectors.note: contentHash is computeContentHash('héllo 日本 😀'). Two refs so the array's count byte is not stuck at 0 or 1 (the ENCODER has no cap — MAX_PARENT_REFS is a validation rule). type is 'profile' (tag 1) — exercises the non-zero tag.

vectors.name: postBody/empty
vectors.note: lpUtf8 of an empty string: a single zero-byte length prefix. The body's standalone wire form, never hashed into anything.

vectors.name: postBody/golden
vectors.note: lpUtf8(content): vlqU(27) followed by 27 UTF-8 bytes. This is the body whose computeContentHash produces the postCommit/golden vector's contentHash.

vectors.name: postBody/multibyte
vectors.note: lpUtf8 counts BYTES, not characters: 11 characters encode as 0x12 = 18 bytes.

rejects.name: postCommit/non-minimal-protocolVersion
rejects.note: postCommit/minimal with protocolVersion written as the padded VLQ `80 00` instead of `00`. Decodes to a byte-identical value, so steps 1 and 2 pass and only the re-encode compare separates it.

rejects.name: postCommit/trailing-byte
rejects.note: postCommit/minimal with one byte appended. The struct is fully satisfied before the input runs out — step 2.

rejects.name: postCommit/truncated-contentHash
rejects.note: Only 20 of contentHash's 32 bytes. Wire's own rejection: a fixed-width read that runs off the end.

rejects.name: postCommit/unknown-type-tag
rejects.note: postCommit/minimal with the type byte set to 0x02 — an unassigned tag. enum8 refuses an unknown tag rather than decoding it to a neighbour.

rejects.name: postCommit/type-sentinel
rejects.note: postCommit/minimal with the type byte set to 0xff — the encode-side sentinel. It must not decode back into a value, so the sentinel is unreachable from a well-formed commit.
